argument_summary: The audit concern is correct that the admissible record does not prove the current model card has already been updated. The narrower supportable position is therefore not unconditional certification-now, but certification as a conditioned packet position: aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal severity support launch readiness context, while the policy predicate is satisfied only upon completion of current-release documentation that reflects the latest evaluation results and explicitly discloses the health-plan benefits support regression for the named use case. On that reading, the packet can defend a caveated certification recommendation without relying on stale approval carryover or informal monitoring as substitutes for required current documentation.
claims_about_business_cost: Business cost is not a policy basis and is not offered as justification. Remaining uncertainty can be handled through a bounded caveat tied to documentation completion rather than automatic escalation, because aggregate readiness and rehearsal evidence do support the launch-readiness portion of the case.
claims_about_policy: The policy does not allow prior approval or informal monitoring notes to replace current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance. It does allow certification when current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. On the present record, the admissible basis supports a conditioned or caveated compliance posture tied to documentation completion, not a claim that the predicate has already been satisfied.
concessions: There is no admissible evidence that the current model card or certification packet has already been updated with the latest evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the subgroup weakness.
The health-plan benefits support regression is a live material limitation for a named use case, so it cannot be treated as a minor informal caveat.
The prior approval from nine weeks ago is contextual only and does not substantively cure the current regression.
The informal monitoring comment is not reviewed mitigation, approved risk acceptance, or proof of compliant disclosure.
